standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145249Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after two fixes. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. tools/check.py --all passes for this issue. Two corrections are recorded here because they changed the computed set. First, the mandatory-reported block less CME block weekly average, the measure this title exists for, had never been computable: it required the two series to share a week ending, and they never do, because the mandatory report's week ends Saturday and the CME reprint's week ends the Friday before. The nearest week within four days is now paired, the same rule the record already used for weekly year-over-year, and the figure records both week-endings and the offset. It is 0.0829 USD per lb, the mandatory week ending 2026-10-10 against the CME week ending 2026-10-09. Second, issue.py built its series map from the named run alone, so the CME reprint, which carries one week per report, reported weeks_in_record as 1 while the record held five; it is now declared accumulates and carries a trailing four-week average, 1.3815 for blocks and 1.4667 for barrels. Remaining gaps: the CME series still carries no year-over-year figure, the record holding five weeks of it. The NDPSR 500-pound barrel series no longer carries a price; the last published figure, 1.9495 for the week ending 2025-05-31, is held as a historical series and is not a current reading. The September baseline has not been recomputed. Publication gated by FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by FA-D-20260923-02 and FA-D-20260923-04.
